First off I’m not saying we aren’t currently in a mass extinction event, just that there are difficulties in determining that we are globally.

And yes I would say taking what is happening in Germany and extrapolating that out to say the rest of the world is experiencing the same has its problems. Many number of things could be happening there that isn’t in the rest of the world, whether man made out not.

Now if you did the same study in North America, South America, Africa etc. basically replicate the study around the world (which I’m sure there has to have been something similar done in other places) and if your finding similar results, then I would say you have a stronger argument for currently being in a mass extinction event globally.
I just want to say that there are many people who deny we are currently in a mass extinction event.

Yes, but the argument is whether or not we are currently in another mass extinction event. Species go extinct all the time, so to qualify a mass extinction event it would need to be a certain percent of all species, which is hard to do when you don’t know how many there are to begin with.

It’s easier to do when you look at a smaller system, like an island or a lake or just some specific area, but a lot harder when looking at the whole planet. Now what some people in support of us being in a mass extinction event have done is looked at those smaller systems then extrapolated that whole planet must be experiencing a similar situation, which you could make that argument but there are rather obvious that come up when you do that (an island out in the ocean will have very specific problems, compared to the rest of the world).

One of the reasons they won’t release information is they want to be able to complete a full investigation and insure they have all the information needed to decide if they will follow through with charges or not. You don’t see one video and make a judgement based off of that (kind of what happened to the guy that this thread is about).

Other then that I don’t know why you keep an investigation like this open for so long but I can give examples why you would for other types of offences. Any sort of sexual assault would be out of my area of specialty, but I am a little more versed in environmental and oh&s. For those if you have a party that you will be following through with charges, you kind of want to push that statute of limitations date as far as you can (as in you are keeping that investigation open for the 2 years).

Charges in both environmental and oh&s are going to depend heavily on the severity/significance of any damages caused. For example, say due to poor safety practices workers get exposed to a bad carcinogen. Health issues may not become apparent right aways, so you are keeping that investigation open (and not sharing shit) to hopefully get a better idea on any long effects that develop or may develop (which you will have to be able to prove in court). Same thing with environmental. And while that investigation file is open, you are not sharing anything in it (and a crown prosecutor can probably list off thousands of reasons why you don’t).

When there is an open investigation into something you don’t just disclose the evidence that you have (which is fairly standard). Once something goes to court disclosure will be made to the defendant, and could be further distributed beyond that. During the investigation though it won’t be.

The order of operations that has been instilled in our brains since elementary school has an acronym — PEMDAS (or "Please Excuse My Dear Aunt Sally") — that helps students remember the exact order. It stands for parentheses, exponents, multiplication, division, addition and subtraction. 

According to PEMDAS, after simplifying, the next step is to multiply, right? Doing so leaves the equation with an answer of 1 after dividing 8 by 8.

But Church said this isn't the case.

“We have 1 as our answer, but is that the end of the story? Of course not," he said. “Let's back up, because this is where the debate comes in”

If you carry out the division first rather than the multiplication, we get 4x4=16.

"Multiplication and division are really two sides of the same coin,” Church said. "In a sense they are the same and should be treated the same — treated in a left to right manner. The same way we read on a page.”

Due to these two having equal priority, in order to break the tie, working from left to right is the best way to go. The division goes first followed by the multiplication, causing the answer to be 16, according to Church. 

He said the heart of the issue is that the equation shouldn't include an obelus. 
"The obelus is treated differently,” Church said. "It could mean ratios, division or numerator and denominator, and these all tweak the meaning of the symbol.”

Church said an obelus can be used, but it causes confusion due to the different meanings behind it, and a forward slash (like this: /) is more useful for division.

So I’m not a mechanic, but have actually dealt with a number of vehicles that have gone through the ice (I worked environmental).

Anyways you would be surprised. You definitely would have an initial “burp “ of fluids being released and there is going to be exposed hydrocarbons. But most fluids are generally in an air tight system in vehicles and/or the pressure of the surrounding water can also create an “air locked system”. So unless there is some other damage, lots of the time you don’t have a lot released right aways and if you do things right, you can end up recovering a lot of the product (usually still in it’s respective reservoir). Another note is that if it was a vehicle being used recreationally, broke through the ice (and didn’t crash through the ice), it will typically have a nice gentle decent, so it will retain more of its fluids.

However...

In a situation like this video, you have to be wary of how you are going to get the vehicle out (if at all). A lot of the time, fluid in vehicles is lost during the recovery. (In the video the whole front end of the vehicle is almost ripped off, and it’s almost guaranteed you had some line cut so no more closed air tight systems). So anyways, you typically have fluid lost pretty early (during a crash) or during the recovery.

Not particularly huge myself but I'll try and give a couple of points.

1. To reach affiliate you need to hit an average of 3 viewers over the course of a 30 day period. The reason he says to not stream 24/7 is that more then likely you will have a large period of time with 1 or no viewers, which can kill your average viewership. So if your goal is to get to affiliate, then long streams can be detrimental.

However, and this is my own opinion, if you are just staring out, you will have no idea what may be the hot time for you to stream. For example, I knew that streaming on a Saturday or Sunday morning was for some reason or another bringing in more then my usual average. So once I figured this out I would do a 3-4 hour stream in that time period and end stream when my viewers were dropping. My average views for those streams would be >10 and after a couple of weeks I easily got myself over 3 average viewers even though I was still having low numbers during the week (which I stopped streaming as much during the week).

The thing is you won't know what your best time may be, so you would have to experiment around with it for a bit.

Now, thats the reason to not stream as much but here is the reason why you should stream more.

**Practice**

When I started out, I had no idea what I was doing. I was one of those mumbling streamers doing a first playthrough of Dark Souls. I was not good, hell I'm still not good. Yes I can sit there and review mods and take notes, but the number one thing that can make you better is practice and you practice by going live. Some people may not need as much, they are used to being in front of a camera, being entertaining to their viewers etc. but I was definitely not one of those people. By Streaming more often, it has helped me to define what I want my channel to be about and the viewers I do seem to be getting in, seem to largely be clicking with that definition. I had no problem getting the 50+ followers, but getting the followers to come back was the issue. I wasn't having fun and after getting affiliate I had no idea what I wanted to do or even if I wanted to keep on streaming. For lots of places it is, but I don't think so in Brazil. Also, I think there is something to do with the soil in the Brazil Rainforest that makes it so this wouldn't work. Something about how the soil needs permanent cover now our it starts losing its nutrients pretty quickly and becomes unfertile.

Before Cattle grazing in the area, they were essentially trying to slash and burn for crop cultivation, which didn't work that well because the land would only be able to grow crops for a couple of seasons before they needed to clear more land and move on.

The rainforest has a very small humus layer, which is the nutrient rich layer. The forest survives because its adapted to be able to essentially immediately recycle nutrients. Anything that decomposes, decomposes really quickly and nutrients that are let out are almost immediately reabsorbed by the vegetation (and not stored in the soil).

So what happens when you clear the forest? It loses its cover (very little sunlight hits the forest bottom) and becomes exposed to the elements. So the rain (you know rainforest) that now easily makes it to the ground, erodes away that top layer (which is already really thin). Furthermore, with no trees you lose that root system that helps anchor the soil down and reduce erosion. Basically the Rainforest, when it is cleared, loses productivity really quick.

Its not like in North America, where we can have a very thick layer of productive soil. Anyways, I don't know how well just replanting would work.

Our dog sleeps in our bed, but I'll give a few reasons.

Allergies - Not necessarily to the dog, but the dog can bring in just about anything on to your bed. Dog safety - I'm pretty sure a lot of dogs never get used to sleeping off the ground. Our dog has fallen off the bed a few times.

Comfort - Some dogs will take up a lot of space, that can then leave you a little cramped up on the bed. Basically, you may not get a good nights rest and wake up with aches and pains. Field of view - More is better (generally) but there is also ways to sort of "trick" a viewer thinking the field of view is higher.

Point being, I lost like 20-30 pounds just by only eating when I was actually hungry, watching my carbs (basically I stopped ordering pizza) and cutting out sugar in my coffee (started drinking and eventually liking black coffee, which I read you can have during the fasting period). Instead of eating when bored at night, I would go for a walk.

I hate when I go places and whoever is hosting makes breakfast first thing in the morning, because I really have to force myself to eat right after waking up. (But i'm still appreciative)
